LanguageData.FilterSignals_CanMake: Your colony can make this item.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_UnableToMake: This colony is unable to make it.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_ToggleTooltip: Click to show or hide this status in the current dialog. Your saved filter will not change.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Feature_Tooltip: Shows production status in vanilla item-filter dialogs. Turning it off does not change saved filters.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Toolbar_Tooltip: Shows four buttons above item filters. They hide or show status groups for the current dialog only. The colored status squares remain available when the toolbar is hidden.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Indicators_Toolti: Shows a colored status square beside each visible item. Hover over it to see why the item has that status.
LanguageData.FilterSignals_Settings_Materials_Tooltip: When enabled, a recipe counts as unavailable if the colony has none of an ingredient's allowed materials. This check is off by default because inventory changes often.
